summary: Verified three targeted FloatingRichTextToolbar fixes (git diff vs HEAD~1): (A) Highlighter stale-active — pending ir-pending-inline + ir-hl-* span no longer lights the Highlighter button unless it contains real (non-ZWSP) text; empty primed markers are also GC'd when the caret moves away. (B) BR line-break caret preservation — insertLineBreak now calls restoreStashedSelectionIfNeeded(editor) BEFORE runExecCommand so the pointerdown focus-steal no longer collapses the Selection to offset 0. (C) List active-state — new `list` field in refreshActive detects UL / OL / UL.ir-checklist ancestors and lights the matching toolbar button; auto-generated data-testids `floating-rte-btn-ul`, `floating-rte-btn-ol`, `floating-rte-btn-checklist`, `floating-rte-btn-br` all present via the existing map at L3331. All three fixes PASS end-to-end on live preview URL.

code_review_of_fix: FloatingRichTextToolbar.jsx L1991-2113 (refreshActive): correctly introduces `list` tracking, scoped to UL/OL ancestor walk. OL takes precedence; `ir-checklist` on UL maps to 'checklist' before falling through to 'ul'. Mutually exclusive by construction (first UL/OL ancestor wins).

L2010-2056: Highlighter rewrite splits span handling into (a) committed hl spans always light, (b) pending-inline-hl spans only light when non-ZWSP text content exists. `pendingHlAncestor` is tracked so the caret-under span is preserved from GC — correct for 'resume priming' UX.

L2078-2096: Stale pending-highlight orphan cleanup — scoped to spans with BOTH ir-pending-inline AND ir-hl-* classes AND empty (ZWSP-only) text content AND not the caret's current ancestor. Safe conditions; cannot wipe legitimate authoring state.

L2832-2841 (insertLineBreak): restoreStashedSelectionIfNeeded is wrapped in try/catch and gated to the HTML path (textarea short-circuits earlier). Order is correct: restore stash → snapshot history → runExecCommand. No regression on textarea path.
L3192-3195 (isToolActive): new cases for ul/ol/checklist compare active.list to the literal. Clean, consistent with existing pattern.

`data-testid={`floating-rte-btn-${t.id}`}` auto-generation at L3331 already produces all four requested testids (ul/ol/checklist/br) since the id definitions at L3093, L3108-3110 use exactly those keys — no explicit testid change needed.
Non-regression: existing active-state logic for bold/italic/underline/strike/link/block/aa/align unchanged. Dirty-check at L2119-2124 extended to compare `list` so no spurious setActive calls.

Minor nit (non-blocking): the stale-highlight cleanup loop (L2085) iterates on every refreshActive invocation (selectionchange / focus / mousemove-ish). On very large notes this is O(N spans) per selection change. Acceptable at current scale but worth batching into a mutation-based GC in the future.

rca_of_the_issue: N/A — this iteration is verification, not RCA. The three underlying root causes were (A) refreshActive marked ANY ancestor span with ir-hl-* as active regardless of whether it was still a pending empty primer; (B) insertLineBreak skipped the shared `restoreStashedSelectionIfNeeded` step that every other format tool uses to compensate for the toolbar's pointerdown focus-steal; (C) refreshActive had no `list` tracking at all, so UL/OL/checklist buttons could never light up. All three were fixed in a single surgical diff.
